newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano soars then retreats on shr issue.
newsitem.headline: Giordano soars then retreats on shr issue.

text.p: Giordano International Ltd shares surged then pulled back in early Friday trade following the company's announcement it had issued new shares to raise HK$196 million for expansion of its China operations.
Its shares jumped HK$0.225, or 4.5 percent, to a high of HK$5.20 before retreating to trade unchanged at HK$4.975 after the first 45 minutes of trade.

"Investors hoped the introduction of new Chinese investors could help dispel concerns over its operations in China and explore new markets there," said Sean Li, an associate director at Amsteel Securities.
Giordano said earlier it had issued a total of 40 million new shares to five China-based companies.
Unfavourable rumours on the retailer's China expansion have dampened sentiment since August 1994 when its flagship China store in Beijing was closed.
The company had said it was seeking strategic investors to beef up its business in China and other markets.
